transcript.text: gas hob keeps clickin on its own since i cleand it, stops then starts agen. drivin me mad. pls help

First switch it off at the wall or cooker switch and let it cool completely. That uncommanded clicking is usually caused by moisture or a misaligned part after cleaning. The most common cause is that a burner cap wasn't seated correctly (it needs to sit perfectly flat) or the ignition electrode near it is still damp. Please check these two things:
1. Lift off each metal burner cap and its inner crown. Make sure they are completely dry inside and out, then place them back so they sit flush and square on the base.
2. Gently wipe the small white ceramic tip of the ignition electrode (the little pin near the flame) with a dry cloth to ensure it's not wet or greasy. Once you've done that, try lighting one burner normally. Does it still click on its own, or does it light and stay lit?
ok did that, one cap was a bit wonky so i put it back flat. wiped some grease off too. i also unplugged the hob for the afternoon and its stopped clicking now. no gas smell btw

That’s excellent news. Leaving it unplugged allowed the moisture to evaporate and the ignition system to reset, which is exactly what was needed. If it ever clicks on its own again, switch it off at the wall for 10 minutes to let the electronics reset. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

candidates: Wet or misaligned burner cap/electrode after cleaning (high)
Ignition module/switch fault triggered by moisture (medium)
